description: This is a Java source file configuring security settings for a Spring Boot application, including CORS, JWT authentication filter, and security filter chain setup.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that sets up security parameters including CORS, JWT filter, session management, and request authorization.

methods.name: filterChain
methods.description: Defines the security filter chain including CORS, CSRF, session management, authorization rules, and JWT filter addition.

methods.name: corsConfiguration
methods.description: Creates and returns a CorsConfiguration object with specified allowed origins, methods, headers, and other settings.

methods.name: authenticationProvider
methods.description: Creates and configures a DaoAuthenticationProvider with password encoder and custom user details service.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Returns a BCryptPasswordEncoder with strength 12 for password hashing.

methods.name: authenticationManager
methods.description: Retrieves the AuthenticationManager from the provided AuthenticationConfiguration.
